mentions.name: Skyrim puzzle-adventure mods
mentions.description: An ongoing side-business creating puzzle-adventure mods for Bethesda games such as Skyrim, built using only the base game's assets, with blending into the world game optional and potentially distinct unique gameplay designed for each modded game.
mentions.problem: During lockdown it was unclear which Bethesda games the paid mods store would cover, so the approach was to design puzzle-adventures from base-game assets that could adapt to whatever titles qualified.
mentions.source_excerpt: I go on with my small side-business of modding Skyrim. During lockdown it wasn't clear what Bethesda games the paid mods store will cover; had it been only for new titles, I had only vague idea that Starfield would be some space sci-fi game, so my idea was to make puzzle-adventures using the base game assets (and blending in the world game is nice but optional), and puzzle-adventure is a very broad genre in itself, so maybe I would end up making up distinct unique gameplay for each of the modded games.
